template.shared_prefix: Answer the source question using its context when relevant.
template.free_form_instruction: Give the factual answer to the question in free form.
template.choice_instruction: Select the best answer from the provided options.
template.shared_suffix: Put your final answer in <answer>...</answer> tags.

design_boundary: Custom crossed diagnostic, not byteexact official constructors or an installed/native upstream evaluation. Choice-without-options and freeform-with-bogus-options are intentional diagnostic interventions. Both baseline prior binding-only and officialtyped endpoints remain archived references, not claimed replicated here. No effects of arbitrary instruction wording or answer-tag format separately identified.
ordering: Source-major fixed stable order. At source rankj, rotate4condition positions byj modulo4 independently per model with model offset2; model presented first alternates byj parity. Across20sources each condition occupies each serial position5times/model and each model leads10sources. Deterministic counterbalance reduces fixed-order confounding, not a randomization-based causal population guarantee.
scoring: Same pinned optional official RULE scorer and immutable source targets across all4conditions, eligibility complete/http200/nonempty/verified request+output hashes only. Preserve official parser counterexamples. Additional final-answer/content adjudication requires separately frozen masked rubric before any newoutputs; do not silently call RULE a capability score or default official modeljudge.
analysis: For each model and20fixedcases, compute instruction contrast (free_form-choice) at each carrier, carrier contrast (absent-present) at each instruction, and interaction. Preserve per-source pairing. Unknown eligible scores range0..1, including every incomplete/unattempted/error; propagate coefficient signs for conservative bounds. Contrasts and interaction describe this panel, not benchmark prevalence. Interaction range may exceed100percentagepoints and must not be mislabeled probability.
